business_problem: Draftwise needed to help lawyers draft and negotiate contracts faster by grounding answers and clause suggestions in clients' contracts, communications, and related documents, while still meeting the legal market's expectations for privacy, security, and highly accurate retrieval.
solution_summary: Draftwise built its Smart Draft contract-drafting product on Cohere models delivered through Microsoft Azure AI Foundry. The workflow uses a retrieval-augmented generation architecture so legal teams can search their own contracts, communications, and prior agreements instead of relying on generic model output. Cohere Embed creates semantic representations across source material, including images, diagrams, tables, and graphs, so lawyers can retrieve precedent by meaning rather than keywords. Cohere Rerank then orders the candidate passages to put the strongest clauses and examples on top, and Cohere Command generates drafting language in a natural interface while citing source documents. Running the stack on Azure let Draftwise combine trusted infrastructure with enterprise-grade search, grounded generation, and multilingual legal support inside one contract workflow.

solution_components.name: Smart Draft
solution_components.role: Provides the contract-drafting interface where lawyers search, draft, and review grounded contract language.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Azure AI Foundry
solution_components.role: Hosts and delivers Cohere models inside the Azure environment Draftwise already trusted.

solution_components.name: Cohere Command
solution_components.role: Generates contract language and can cite the source documents used in the draft.

solution_components.name: Cohere Embed
solution_components.role: Turns source documents and queries into semantic representations for retrieval over legal content.

solution_components.name: Cohere Rerank
solution_components.role: Reorders retrieved passages so the most relevant clauses and examples appear first.

data_flow: Client contracts, communications, and related legal documents are indexed semantically with Cohere Embed; when a lawyer asks Smart Draft for a clause or draft, Azure AI Foundry retrieves candidate passages, Cohere Rerank reorders them by relevance, and Cohere Command produces grounded contract language with citations back to the original material.
business_outcome: Draftwise improved search-result quality by 30%, saw a threefold increase in API usage in the first quarter of 2025, and gave lawyers more time for strategic client work by reducing the manual review and repetitive drafting that had turned many into 'cut-and-paste drones.'
